name: PCB Fab Laser SVG Export
description: Export SVG layers (B.Cu negative, B.SilkS, Edge.Cuts) for xTool laser PCB fabrication.
description_full: Generates two SVG files: an 'ablate' SVG containing the union of (board outline minus B.Cu copper) and B.SilkS, and a 'cut' SVG containing Edge.Cuts. Bottom layers are mirrored. 1:1 mm scale.
